constraints: evt.occurrence.sales_close is authorized only for an authorized human organizer
offer.quote.create grants no buyer access to PRICE actions
Do not add price.quote.create; PRICE snapshot actions are subordinate governed invocations from OFFER
System automatic sales close is an EVT-2 system initiator policy and is not an IAM organizer capability; never authorize system through a human capability

Every capability_action_map key MUST resolve to exactly one capability_definitions entry with non-empty, schema-valid allowed_actor_kinds and allowed_roles; every role in those mapped definitions MUST resolve to exactly one role_definitions entry.
T0 tenant capabilities MUST be evaluated against an active org persona and MUST NOT accept a platform or support persona unless a separately governed support-mode policy names that capability.
T0 platform.tax_rate.create MUST be evaluated against an active platform persona with platform scope and org_id=nil.
Buyer capability grants MUST NOT confer access to subordinate PRICE actions.
Customer role assignments MUST be created through IAM-2 invite acceptance only; IAM-1 iam.role.assign MUST NOT create a customer assignment directly.

AuthIdentity.provider_subject: Opaque, stable, non-PII identifier supplied by trusted provider; never an email address or phone number.
AuthIdentity.resolution_requirement: resolve through a trusted provider to AuthIdentity

identity.User: Global non-PII principal identity only; no direct email or phone attributes.
identity.pii_boundary: PII-1 alone owns direct identifiers and tenant-bound PII evidence. IAM MUST NOT expose or use PII-1 subject_lookup_key_hash.

capability_definitions.description: View aggregated dashboards.
Drill down into metric dimensions (subject to PII-1 and BI privacy thresholds).
Authorize exports that are capped at data_class c0–c2 (no restricted PII). Requires projection allowlists, async authorization re-check, and audited delivery.
Request exports of non-sensitive aggregate data (C0-C2).
Authorize exports that may include data_class c3 (restricted PII). Requires elevated reason code, strict projection allowlists, async authorization re-check, and redaction-safe audit logging.
Authorize exports that may include data_class c4 (regulated/high-risk). Reserved for platform super_admin workflows (e.g., DSAR execution / regulator response) and requires break-glass governance.
Approve execution of an org-scoped DSAR after validation.
Approve a platform-wide DSAR batch execution (explicit multi_org_scope required).
Break-glass DSAR override; requires step-up auth, mandatory reason, enhanced monitoring.
Execute DSAR actions asynchronously as background jobs using least privilege.
Submit a DSAR case (org-scoped default; platform_support may submit platform-wide batch with explicit scope).
Validate DSAR requestor identity evidence and mark case as verified.
Create an organization-scoped Event.
Publish an organization-scoped Event.
Start an A/B test experiment for an event surface.
capability_definitions.notes: EVT-2: only super_admin can start/stop experiments. System may propose stop; human confirms.

capability_definitions.description: Confirm stopping an experiment (after system proposal or manual decision).
Create an organization-scoped Occurrence.
Close sales for an organization-scoped Occurrence as a human organizer.
Open sales for an organization-scoped Occurrence.
Grant private access (invite/membership/ACL hook) for event/occurrence.
Revoke private access grant for event/occurrence.
Override default redirect retention for evergreen landing pages.
Execute a break-glass administrative action (restricted).
notes: Reserved for infrastructure-level recovery; requires explicit audit trail.

capability_definitions.description: Start an impersonation session for support/debug (must record reason).
notes: Must set auth_context.impersonator_info and be fully audited.

capability_definitions.description: Stop an impersonation session and return to the original actor.
Invite a user to join an organization.
notes: Invitation issuance belongs to IAM-2; policy atom lives here.

capability_definitions.description: Remove a user from an organization.
notes: Must revoke org grants and invalidate org-scoped sessions where applicable.

capability_definitions.description: Enroll a high-assurance MFA factor (TOTP/WebAuthn) for admin use.
notes: Enrollment and verification state machine is defined in IAM-3.

capability_definitions.description: Revoke a high-assurance MFA factor for an actor.
notes: Must trigger immediate StepUpGrant invalidation and session re-evaluation.

capability_definitions.description: Approve an MFA reset request for another actor within org scope.
notes: Recommended time-lock activation. Reset flow belongs to IAM-3.

capability_definitions.description: Execute an MFA reset (support/nuclear option).
notes: Must be manually verified and audited; should revoke all sessions immediately.

capability_definitions.description: Request an MFA reset for the current actor (self-service).
Assign a role to an actor within scope (org/platform).
notes: Must be audited. Requires IAM-3 step-up for admin actors.

capability_definitions.description: Revoke a role from an actor within scope (org/platform).
notes: Must be audited. Requires IAM-3 step-up for admin actors.

capability_definitions.description: Revoke all active sessions for a target actor (force re-login).
notes: Used for account takeover response, MFA reset, or critical role change.

capability_definitions.description: Revoke the current session (logout).
Revoke an elevated step-up grant (invalidate assurance for the session).
notes: Used for incident response or after sensitive operations.

capability_definitions.description: Perform a step-up verification to obtain an elevated session assurance grant.
notes: Verification methods are defined by IAM-3.

capability_definitions.description: Activate an organization-scoped Offer.
Create an organization-scoped Offer.
Create an organization-scoped OfferWindow.
Activate an organization-scoped Product.
Create an organization-scoped Product.
Create an organization-scoped ProductRevision.
Build a buyer-facing cart quote for the active customer in the same organization.
Create an Order checkout for the active customer in the same organization.
Override anonymization threshold for approved export-only workflows; results treated as PII export.
Generate a PII export artifact with mandatory audit reason and time-limited retrieval token.
Read PII vault alias mappings for approved workflows. NOT granted to support by default.
Emergency access to PII vault with step-up auth, mandatory reason, extra monitoring and post-facto governance review.
Create a platform-scoped TaxRate.
Create an organization-scoped pricing program.
Create a phase in an organization-scoped pricing program revision.
Activate an organization-scoped pricing program revision.
Create an organization-scoped pricing program revision.
Create a rule in an organization-scoped pricing program revision.
Generate and distribute offline hydration manifests to scanner devices.
Redeem/consume ticket credential at entry (online or offline).
Validate ticket credential at entry (online or offline).
Claim inventory in an organization-scoped bucket as the active customer.
Create an organization-scoped inventory bucket.

Create an organization-scoped TaxProfile.

decision_api.purpose: Deterministic authorization evaluation for synchronous requests and async workers.

notes: If any required status is not met, authorization MUST fail closed as ERR_FORBIDDEN/ERR_UNAUTHENTICATED per IAM-1 error policy.
Workers MUST treat liveness as time-of-use, not time-of-schedule.

role_definitions.description: Platform operator responsible for payouts, tax configurations, and ledger reconciliation.
Organization member responsible for banking details, refunds, and financial reporting.
Organization-scoped buyer persona assigned through IAM-2 invite acceptance only.

resources.description: Optional org-managed access grants (ACL hooks) for private events/occurrences and other resources.
resources.name: AccessGrant

resources.description: Global mapping keyed by the exact pair (issuer, provider_subject). provider_subject is an opaque, stable, non-PII identifier supplied by a trusted authentication provider. It is not an email address or phone number. Resolve this mapping for password, magic-link, OAuth, and service-token authentication before organization selection. The same mapped principal_id applies across all organizations.
resources.name: AuthIdentity

resources.description: Separately governed platform role assignment; never carries org role semantics.
resources.name: PlatformRoleAssignment

dependencies.reason: Phase-5 registry head parity; outbox required_keys must match EVT-1 required_data_keys exactly (ordered).

anti_enumeration.rule: sign_in and sign_up and account_lookup failures MUST return ERR_UNAUTHENTICATED with uniform timing/messaging; public recovery flows MUST use uniform 202-accepted responses (password_reset_request, magic_link_request) and uniform invalid/expired for token consumption (password_reset_consume, magic_link_consume, email_verify_consume).

authorization.active_persona_rule: When actor has multiple roles across org/platform, each request SHALL carry an explicit active_scope and active_role; authorization MUST be evaluated against the active persona only.
authorization.assurance_semantics: aal1=authenticated session; aal2=step-up grant issued by IAM-3; aal3=hardware-backed step-up (future).
notes: EVT-2: experiments may only be started/stopped by super_admin.
EVT-2: private access uses invite + account + membership, plus optional org-managed grants stored in IAM-1 as hooks.
Do not interpret assurance_level using >= comparisons. Treat it as an exact policy gate.
IAM-2 consumer OTP/email flows MUST set verification_flags/consumer_otp_verified_at_utc, NEVER assurance_level.
Only IAM-3 StepUpGrant issuance may transition assurance_level to aal2/aal3 within a session.
authorization.org_membership_identity_rule: When an active org persona is selected, auth_context.actor.org_membership_id MUST equal the stable, server-generated, immutable UUIDv7 identifier of that selected active OrgMembership row. When no active org persona is selected, auth_context.actor.org_membership_id MUST be nil.

org_selection.active_scope_binding: Requests MUST include org_id for org-scoped actions; platform-scoped actions MUST have org_id=nil. Mixed-scope requests MUST be rejected.
org_selection.rule: Sessions bind org_id via sign_in_with_org validating active OrgMembership. Pre-auth context does not persist.

resolution_rule.text: IAM MUST be able to compute subject_key_hash from (org_id, subject_id) deterministically and MUST treat the mapping as tenant-scoped.

canonicalization.unicode_normalization: none (uuid-only); NFC required if non-UUID inputs are introduced

subject_key_hash_derivation.stability_rule: MUST remain stable; algorithm_version MUST NOT change before Phase 6; canonicalization MUST be byte-identical across implementations.

tombstone_policy.text: If a subject_id is purged, systems that store subject_key_hash for indexing MUST retain a tombstone keyed by subject_key_hash for the retention window to prevent ghost re-collection.

owned_slots.description: IAM-owned allow-list slot for offline scanning. Produces the actor_ids permitted to operate scanner flows for a specific occurrence at snapshot time.
determinism_rules: The produced list MUST be a set derived from AccessGrant rows and then deterministically ordered (lex_asc) after UUID lowercase normalization.
In offline contexts, actor_id is the principal identifier; for human principals it MUST equal user_id. This slot treats AccessGrant.subject_user_id as actor_id.

summary: Secure user authentication, session management, and org-scoped access with deterministic org binding, UUIDv7 IDs, utc_datetime_usec timestamps, and bounded telemetry.
